scope: One preregistered finite native compiler graph on a shared real x86-64 host; three groups; no repeated timing after outcomes
motivation: Previous full-cost graph lost to strong controls. Reuse one sealed native evaluator process and add the independently verified guarded+narrowing chain; retain the same strong complete-plan and DP controls.
horizon_selection: Before registration and before any new graph workload, choose the larger declared work horizon using previous negative graph costs and the separate round3 benchmark's observed preparation costs. No timing from this new graph is available; strong controls and all costs are unchanged.
acceptance: Every episode completes within the same budget with correct loaded native outputs; full standalone total NDU cost across all three groups is lower than both strong fixed and lightweight DP controls. Medians are descriptive only. This is a descriptive finite-host gate, not statistical or universal superiority.
wrapper_cost: The entire measured outer wrapper registration/identity/host/evidence interval is additionally charged to NDU as an explicitly conservative surcharge, including shared portions; original equal-scope strategy totals are published separately. Final aggregate result serialization and affinity restoration remain excluded.

graph.same_information: Identical complete measured candidate bank and completed episode observations
graph.future_information: Declared workload inputs only; future execution times unavailable
graph.fixed_control: Complete minimum-cost calibrated plan committed after the common first probe
graph.light_control: Complete additive finite-horizon dynamic programming replanned after actual observations
graph.control_encoding: Fixed and lightweight controls avoid native-event serialization and retain the same full path space/budget
graph.native_control: Unchanged original NDU evaluation in a bounded sealed-image stream session
graph.cost_model: Per-size calibration medians scaled by observed same-state wall ratios
graph.recompilation: Every changed state reproposes and independently proves/builds final native bytes
graph.decision_value: Future increments; all historical costs remain in the cost ledger
graph.budget: Same before/after-stage deadline and remaining subprocess timeout for every arm
graph.artifact_execution: SHA-matched sealed inherited memfd with actual symbol mapping check
graph.setup: Common calibration charged once per standalone strategy; actual empty-target native build/admission/control/shutdown charged to NDU
